title: Introduce a synchronized shard with exclusive writer ownership
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Assign a new shard before/after synchronization; reject ambiguous writer ownership.
exactSourceBehavior: Copy and synchronize data before changing routing, with unambiguous write ownership.
exactParentAcceptance: Committed data is copied/synchronized before handoff; fencing prevents missing or duplicate writes.
preconditions: Standalone modern browser with local JavaScript. No server, account, authentication, credentials, subscription or cloud resource.
One fixed synthetic tenant starts on shard-a at epoch 1; shard-b receives 1 to 6 copied committed effects.
1 to 3 additional effects commit on the source while the snapshot is copied.
Exclusive ownership is an explicit synthetic fixture assumption, not independent evidence of actual writer fencing.
actions: Choose copied effects, further source commits, and assignment before or after synchronization.
Choose complete, snapshot-only or unobserved synchronization and exclusive, ambiguous or unobserved ownership.
Inspect gate observations, required/copied/candidate effect IDs, route, writer epoch, and synthetic trace.
Compare SUCCESS, FAILURE and UNKNOWN metrics across up to 8 independent retained attempts.
Use keyboard submission, focused errors and explicit reset.
syntheticInputAndTrace: Bounded generated effect-1 through effect-9; fixed training-tenant-1 and shard-a/shard-b. One synthetic new write and a stale-source retry of the SAME operation ID only after the assignment gate allows transfer. Accepted ledger entries determine effect and duplicate counts.
expectedAssertions: Copied and synchronized required committed effects plus exclusive modeled ownership permit assignment.
Early assignment and snapshot-only data coverage are blocked with missing committed effects reported.
Two proposed writer owners are rejected even when data is synchronized.
Missing observations are UNKNOWN, known failure dominates, and blocked probes are not falsely reported as successful zero-duplicate tests.
No invalid input, forged state or attempt 9 changes retained history.
Actual DOM, keyboard, error, failure, reset and restrictive CSP checks use only the published isolated browser helper.

bounds.history: Memory only; independent comparisons, cleared by reset or reload.

iac.sequence: After genuine loadable-stub assertion RED and before implementation.
iac.reason: No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity registration, deployment or spending is authorized.

browserTooling.lifecycle: openIsolatedLesson and awaited finally close; abandoned lifecycle prototype is unqualified.

limits: No actual database copying, synchronization, shard creation, live routing, writer fencing or native Azure proof.
No production Node.js 24, completed B-S064/D-S064/D-S054, uninterrupted-user or five-nines certification.
Only learning/S064 is owned. No root/shared edits, packages, framework, downloads, unsafe flags or foreground leases.
One frozen S unit. Tests, proof, plumbing and refinement earn no additional units.
Normal tests are read-only to historical proof; CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 is deliberate capture only.
